strategic_goals.title: Make essential public services easier to access
strategic_goals.outcome_metric: Share of synthetic service journeys completed with the required channel, deadline protection, and recourse

strategic_goals.title: Improve information quality and operational integrity
strategic_goals.outcome_metric: Exact record rate after independent human quality review

strategic_goals.title: Reduce avoidable processing burden
strategic_goals.outcome_metric: Median human handling minutes per completed synthetic case without increased error or appeal loss

use_cases.title: Paper form digitization for eastern processing
use_cases.mission: Extract declared fields from scanned public-service forms and route uncertain fields to human verification.
use_cases.expected_benefit: Reduce manual transcription while preserving field-level verification and the original record.
use_cases.system_boundary: The system extracts and flags fields; a records specialist accepts every corrected record.
use_cases.human_authority: Records specialist accepts the official digitized record.

use_cases.title: Paper form digitization for western processing
use_cases.mission: Extract declared fields from scanned public-service forms and route uncertain fields to human verification.
use_cases.expected_benefit: Reduce regional transcription backlog while retaining source-image access and human correction.
use_cases.system_boundary: The system extracts and flags fields; it cannot alter the source image or finalize an agency record.
use_cases.human_authority: Regional records specialist accepts the official digitized record.

use_cases.title: Benefit notice plain-language review
use_cases.mission: Check synthetic draft notices for missing explanation, recourse, authority, and declared communication needs.
use_cases.expected_benefit: Increase the share of synthetic notices that preserve explanation, recourse, and declared communication needs.
use_cases.system_boundary: The system reviews and flags a draft; a trained employee determines content and sends the notice.
use_cases.human_authority: Authorized correspondence reviewer approves or rejects each draft.

use_cases.title: Program-integrity case prioritization
use_cases.mission: Surface synthetic records for human review using declared evidence-quality and risk indicators.
use_cases.expected_benefit: Help analysts focus limited review time without labeling a person as fraudulent or changing payment status.
use_cases.system_boundary: The system prioritizes synthetic review queues and cannot label fraud, deny service, hold funds, or refer a case.
use_cases.human_authority: Authorized program-integrity officials decide investigation, referral, payment, and adverse action.

use_cases.title: Internal meeting summary assistant
use_cases.mission: Draft a synthetic summary and action list from an internal training meeting.
use_cases.human_authority: Meeting owner corrects the draft before distribution.

use_cases.title: Public service navigation chatbot
use_cases.mission: Route synthetic questions to current official service information and preserve accessible channels and human escalation.
use_cases.beneficiary: Members of the public seeking service information
use_cases.expected_benefit: Increase correct first-route guidance without hiding staffed or accessible service channels.
use_cases.system_boundary: The system retrieves public information and routes questions; it cannot determine eligibility or alter a record.
use_cases.human_authority: Authorized service employees answer case-specific questions and make every program decision.
